Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

We are looking for an experienced Azure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD Engineer to help elevate our SaaS operations and internal deployment processes to the next level.

Key about your role

We aim to take Operations to the next level by onboarding more skilled human power (you) and using your expertise to refine and modernize our existing Azure setup. The goal is to make it more elegant, clean, and scalable.

As a central figure in the infrastructure everyone depends on, communication and collaboration will be a natural part of your work. You will provide ad hoc support to colleagues and customer representatives, contributing directly to the stability and growth of our platform.

We work with two layers of deployments:

• Platform deployments: Low frequency (around once per month), planned well in advance.

• Customer component deployments: Higher frequency (around once per week), shorter planning horizon.

Both typically take place outside normal office hours. For these, you will be compensated with time off from your regular schedule. Deployments usually last about 15 minutes, with occasional on-call backup needed for unforeseen issues (fortunately, rare).

Your work will revolve around three main areas as follows:

Key responsibilities:

• 
Environments: Refining and improving the setup of our internal and external environments in a beautiful Kubernetes architecture in Azure.

• 
CI/CD: Configuring, maintaining and continuously improving our entire CI/CD universe.

• 
Operations: Participate actively in operations tasks, maintenance windows, deployments, and incident debugging.

Together with the small operations team, ensure our platform runs smoothly 24/7.

There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

Key about your Team

Our team, named Obex, is a business unit of Keylane, employing around twenty-five awesome developers, business analysts and a few other professions. Our main product is our Obex Platform, a SaaS solution for financial advisory used by advisors in a variety of pension funds and banks.

We are proud that finances of an estimated two million Danes have been through our software. The Obex Platform is developed in close collaboration with our customers, resulting in a product that users truly appreciate.

In Obex we care for each other. Thriving is top priority. You will feel that atmosphere as soon as you enter.

Our organization is flat, the best argument wins, not the highest title. We do things because they make sense. If something stops making sense, we stop doing it, whether that’s a process, a line of code, or a piece of architecture. We aim for the best solutions, not for rigid conformity.

We believe in mutual elasticity: We go the extra mile to support you, each other, and our customers. And we expect the same spirit in return. Together, we share responsibility for keeping the Obex machine running smoothly.

There’s much more to tell about our way of working, our culture, and our social side (fun activities and parties included), but let’s save that for a chat, either online or over a great cup of coffee.

Questions?

If you have any further questions regarding this position, please reach out to the hiring manager Rasmus Amossen via mail to rasmus.amossen@keylane.com.

When you have any general questions about Keylane or want to have a quick chat before applying, just reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Thomas Thomsen via mail to thomas.thomsen@keylane.com.

Requirements

Experience?

• You are fluent in Kubernetes, have solid experience with Azure services, virtual network configuration, and Azure DevOps.

• You know your way around log and performance monitoring tools and have a passion for clean, well-architected systems.

• You are not content with things merely working, you want them to work beautifully.

• Our platform uses .NET on the backend, React with Typescript on the frontend, and Aspire for local development orchestration. Experience with these technologies is a plus.

• There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

Using AI

• You are interested in using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex as part of the software development lifecycle. For example, to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, generate or improve code and tests, refactoring, troubleshoot issues, document solutions and support code reviews;

• You understand that AI-generated code and suggestions must be critically evaluated, tested and reviewed. You take ownership of the quality, security, correctness and maintainability of the code you deliver;

Other

Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously

A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

Benefits

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment

• A profit share

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 43.000 - 56.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Intro

Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories, including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal, and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Key Account Manager, Pharmacy for our office in Copenhagen.

What’s in it for you?

This is a high-impact commercial role where you will take real ownership of key pharmacy partnerships, influence how our brands win in-store, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce and external partners. You’ll join a fast-moving international business where ideas turn into action quickly and where there is plenty of room to shape the role, grow your commercial expertise and make a visible impact.

What you’ll be doing

• Develop and execute customer strategies for key pharmacy accounts together with the Sales Director, Brand Managers and E-commerce KAM.

• Plan, submit, execute and evaluate trade campaigns together with internal teams and external agencies.

• Build, strengthen and grow strategic relationships with existing pharmacy partners.

• Lead annual customer planning, commercial negotiations and account development.

• Identify commercial opportunities that drive sustainable growth, profitability and sell-out performance.

• Ensure customer campaigns, pricing, assortment, product information and commercial activities are implemented accurately and on time.

• Act as a commercial sparring partner to Brand Managers to create best-in-class brand visibility and in-store execution.

• Manage key wholesaler processes, including maintenance of pricing, assortment and customer information.

• Take ownership of the CRM system supporting pharmacy sales representatives and help ensure effective commercial execution of key pharmacy accounts

• Use customer, market and commercial insights to continuously improve performance, service levels and ways of working.

Requirements

• Master’s degree, professional bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in a relevant field.

• Solid experience from a commercial, sales or key account management environment.

• Being structured and managing customer processes diligently and promptly

• Experience working with B2C customers, ideally within FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, retail or another fast-moving industry.

• Experience with the Danish pharmacy market or consumer healthcare sector is an advantage.

• Strong commercial mindset with experience in customer negotiations, account planning and business development.

• Excellent relationship management and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset with a strong “go-do” attitude.

• Comfortable taking ownership, working independently and building structure in a dynamic environment.

• Commercially and financially minded, with the ability to balance customer opportunities with profitable growth.

• Able to maintain a strong overview while managing multiple priorities in a changing international business.

Benefits

• Opportunity to create, grow, and encourage

• Apart from a competitive salary pack, there are lots of growth opportunities to meet your personal ambitions

• Flexible schedule and life work balance

• Responsibility for exciting and challenging projects that have a direct, visible impact on our customers and the industry

• Very positive work environment in a young, international, and motivated team

• Start-up spirit while being a part of the large international organization with strong values

Karo Healthcare has a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age.

Our purpose is to offer smart choices for everyday healthcare and we are passionately working towards realising our vision of Karo becoming a pan-European leader in everyday healthcare. With this ambitious growth strategy, we are constantly scouting for new talents to join our existing dynamic and high-paced Karo team. Embracing diverse perspectives and backgrounds is a part of our identity, and an equal representation of women and men in management positions. If you want to work for a dynamic high-growth company that is flat, non-bureaucratic, and that empowers colleagues to make their own decisions through the trust placed in their capabilities and alignment to our strategic goals and vision – check out our current vacancies.

At Claimlane, we're looking for a problem solving focused Product Designer. You'll spend most of your time talking directly to customers to understand how they work through their problems today, then shape and validate the right solution with the team and finally design the solution. This is a problem-solving role first, design second.

You will enjoy this role if you are curious, work fast, and appreciate the opportunity to have a huge impact on our product.

About Claimlane

Claimlane is a rapidly growing B2B SaaS scale-up. We fix complex claims and returns processes for top retailers and brands like Matas, Coolshop, Black Diamond, and Tonies.

We're looking for A-players who want to make a difference and grow with the business. We value a strong positive attitude, a high sense of ownership, and long-term thinking. Attitude beats talent.

We want to build a billion-dollar business, and part of that is building a team with billion-dollar potential.

The Role

You will spend the majority of your time solving problems, not producing designs & screens. That process starts with talking directly to customers and the team, mapping out how customers work through a problem today, and building a clear, written definition of how to build a better solution for them. Only once the problem is deeply understood do you shape a solution, and even then, you validate it with real customer feedback before treating it as done and ready to be designed.

You will work in close collaboration with product and engineering from day one, and you will rapidly take on more independence as you build context. Within your first month, you will be solving smaller problems on your own. Within three months, you will independently own problem definition and design for solutions end to end.

This is a junior-to-mid-level role built for fast growth. You do not need years of product design experience, but you do need to be an exceptional problem solver who is comfortable getting close to customers, curious about how things actually work, and eager to grow into a stronger product designer along the way.

Key Responsibilities

• Talk directly to customers and the team to deeply understand problems and map them out.

• Turn ambiguous problems into clear, written problem definitions before shaping a solution.

• Design and ship solutions for working closely with engineering & customer facing team.

• Run customer and user-testing conversations and turn findings into concrete product improvements or new solutions.

• Gather feedback on shipped work and use it to shape the next iteration.

• Take on progressively larger and more ambiguous problems as you build context and trust with product and engineering.

Requirements

• Exceptional problem solver who structures ambiguous situations into a clear definition before jumping to a solution.

• Comfortable talking directly to customers and mapping out their workflows to understand a problem from the ground up.

• Strong visual and UX sense, able to turn a well-understood problem into clean, modern, and readable designs.

• Clear communicator who can explain design decisions and trade-offs in handoffs to engineering, including edge cases.

• Quick learner who picks up new tools, product domains, and feedback fast.

• Balances speed and quality, knowing when good enough is the right call to keep the team moving.

• Low-ego, high-energy collaborator who works transparently and takes feedback well.

Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

• Running customer interviews or user research independently.

• Working directly with engineers on technical constraints and trade-offs.

• Working in B2B SaaS or scale-up environment.

• Figma and modern design tooling.

Location and Compensation

Our office is in Nørrebro, Copenhagen, and this is an in-office role. Our team enjoys coming in, and everyone has the flexibility to shape their workday around their lifestyle.

Our compensation package is competitive, and we offer an attractive warrants and stock program.

If you're a positive, ambitious person who wants to build real problem-solving muscle as a product designer, Claimlane will be the right vehicle for you, and we'd love to welcome you. Don't waste time, apply now! 🚀

Hiring Process

• Intro Call: A 15 to 30 minute conversation to see if we click.

• Culture Interview: A 1 to 2 hour deep dive into values, mindset, and team fit.

• Problem-Solving Case: A 1 to 3 hour session working through a real customer problem, from understanding it to proposing a solution. No polished mockups required. We're flexible if you prefer another format, so feel free to shine in your own way.

• Team Meetup: A 30 minute chance to say hi to the team.

• References: A final check before we make things official.

Apply on LinkedIn or send your resume to asl@claimlane.com. We review candidates on an ongoing basis. Sending a 60 second video introducing yourself will move you to the top of the stack, though it's not required.

About the job

Are you at the start of your career and ready to help shape Saxo's balance sheet analytics, risk frameworks, and treasury decision-making through data, modelling and quantitative analysis?

We are looking for a talented and motivated Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our Market & Treasury Risk team within Risk Strategy & Treasury. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of treasury, risk management, quantitative modelling, and strategic decision-making.

Our team plays a central role in shaping Saxo's earnings profile and balance sheet risks, including liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk and capital risk. We develop and maintain the analytical frameworks, models and methodologies that support balance sheet optimisation, risk management and senior management decision-making across the organisation.

As part of the team, you will contribute to the development of quantitative models, risk metrics as well as analytical tools used to assess earnings, funding, liquidity and market risks. You will work closely with colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading and Technology, gaining broad exposure to the management of a modern international bank.

This role is particularly well suited to professionals in the earlier stages of their career looking to build deep expertise in treasury, risk management and quantitative analysis within an international banking environment.

Responsibilities

As our new Quantitative Risk Analyst, you will:

• 
Develop and enhance quantitative models, methodologies, and risk measures relating to liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk, and capital management.

• 
Build analytical models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide insights into earnings, funding, liquidity, and risk exposures.

• 
Perform quantitative analysis of balance sheet developments, business initiatives, and market events to support risk and treasury decision-making.

• 
Contribute to the automation and improvement of risk analytics using modern analytical tools and programming languages.

• 
Assist in the development and validation of methodologies used for risk measurement, forecasting, and scenario analysis.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading, Secured Finance, and Technology to deliver scalable analytical solutions.

• 
Support the preparation of analysis and material for senior management, risk committees, and regulatory interactions.

• 
Support the ongoing development of analytical frameworks such as Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), Value of Client Funds (VCF), stress-testing methodologies, and balance sheet optimisation tools.

Your profile

This role is ideally suited to candidates with around 4-5 years of relevant experience who are looking to further develop their quantitative, analytical, and banking expertise while taking on increasing responsibility and ownership. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience if they bring highly relevant expertise and a strong foundation within the areas covered by the role.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems through data, modelling, and quantitative analysis. You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by understanding how financial and business decisions impact earnings, risk, and balance sheet performance.

You are comfortable working with data, challenging assumptions, and developing practical solutions while collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders.

In addition, we expect that you:

• 
Hold a relevant master's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, physics, computer science or a related quantitative discipline.

• 
Have experience with Python, SQL, R, AI/ML tools, or similar analytical and programming technologies

• 
Possess strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience working with complex datasets and modelling frameworks.

• 
Enjoy developing models, analytical tools, and scalable solutions to support business decision-making.

• 
Have an interest in financial markets, banking, treasury or risk management.

• 
Communicate clearly and explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have:

• 
Experience with liquidity risk, FTP, IRRBB, market risk, stress testing, or capital management.

• 
Knowledge of banking products, financial markets, or asset and liability management.

• 
Experience with data visualisation, automation, or large-scale data analysis.

• 
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks applicable to banks and financial institutions.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: Analyst (Student Assistant), Growth Markets Funds Investment Team
jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is the perfect place for you! We are currently looking for ambitious Analyst (Student Assistant) to join our Growth Markets Funds Investment Team in Copenhagen.

Team

The Growth Market Funds (GMF) invest in renewable energy infrastructure in high-growth middle-income markets with strong fundamentals for renewable development and significant impact potential. The funds target markets across Asia, Latin America and EMEA with strong fundamentals for renewable energy infrastructure investments with a combination of high economic and demographic growth including an expanding middle class leading to an accelerating electricity demand.

You will work closely together with highly experienced colleagues in an international and dynamic environment. We will constantly seek to inspire you, while focusing on your learning and personal development. Working with our skilled team members, you will build a solid commercial and contractual understanding of renewable energy infrastructure projects and how they are financed.

Role

As a Student Analyst, you will contribute to transaction processes, preparing for investment decisions, analyzing and reporting on investment performance and various other tasks.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

• 
Preparation of Investment Committee materials

• 
Visualization and presentation of technical and financial data to stakeholders

• 
Financial modelling of large complex infrastructure assets including project finance

• 
Working together with industrial partners and advisors

• 
Ad-hoc analyses in close collaboration with other team members

The position is part-time and based in our headquarters in NordØ. The workload will vary depending on the numbers of projects you are working on, and you will be given the opportunity to influence your daily routine and schedule.

You

CIP is looking for 2nd and 3rd year BSc students in Economics, Business, Finance, Engineering, or any other relevant field.

We are looking for the following candidate:

• 
High academic achievements

• 
Great communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• 
Interest in corporate finance, strategy, and renewable energy

• 
Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint

• 
Strong analytical aptitude and structured and project-oriented approach to work

• 
Ability to deliver high quality output in a time-sensitive setting

• 
Curious and creative mindset and spirit of inquiry

• 
Ability to work with limited supervision, at the same time enjoying teamwork and engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• 
Experience in energy and infrastructure is beneficial, but not a requirement

Please note that we do not offer a remote working opportunity, thus you must be a Danish resident to be eligible for this role. Students on exchange in Denmark are not considered eligible for this position.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

Building value that matters

Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

jobs.occupation: Consultant, Procurement Advisory - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:
Curious about how leading organizations make smarter buying decisions? Join our Procurement Advisory team and help clients transform the way they work with suppliers, use data, and leverage digital tools to create measurable business value. From day one, you'll be involved in projects that make a real impact, turning complex challenges into practical improvements.

About the role

Procurement is changing quickly. Organizations are using data, AI, automation and digital platforms to make better decisions, improve supplier collaboration and create more resilient operations. As a Consultant in Procurement Advisory, you will help clients navigate that change while building a solid foundation in consulting, sourcing and source-to-pay transformation.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues on projects across the entire sourcing process, from analysis and strategy to implementation and governance, contributing to impactful projects across both private and public organizations. You will help design and deliver solutions that improve procurement performance and support strategic objectives. You will play a key role in translating data and technology into actionable insights while becoming part of an environment where professionalism, innovation, and collaboration go hand in hand.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• 
Analyze procurement processes, spend and supplier information, and turn findings into clear recommendations e.g. through business cases, sourcing strategies or outsourcing models.

• 
Support the design and implementation of procurement strategies, future-fit operating models, processes and digital solutions.

• 
Explore how AI, automation, analytics and procurement technologies can improve transparency, decision-making and performance across sourcing and procurement processes.

Perks of joining Procurement Advisory

Our team combines procurement expertise, business transformation and technology. This means you will not be limited to analyzing a problem or writing a strategy. You will also help translate recommendations into processes, operating models and solutions that can work in practice.

Learn by doing: You will take part in real client work from the beginning, with guidance from colleagues who will help you build confidence and increase your responsibility over time.

Work across disciplines: You will collaborate with procurement & sourcing specialists, technology consultants, data experts and international colleagues from across KPMG, giving you broad exposure while you develop a clear functional specialism.

Shape a growing area: You will join a close and motivated team where ideas are welcomed, knowledge is shared and junior colleagues are encouraged to contribute to client delivery, proposals and the continued development of our services.

About you, our new team member

You enjoy working with people and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and mutual support are valued. At the same time, you appreciate a positive and social workplace where professional excellence and having fun go hand in hand.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:

• 
Is curious about how organizations and their procurement functions operate.

• 
Enjoys turning complex information into clear and actionable transformation stories.

• 
Has an interest in sourcing, outsourcing, supplier management and/or procurement.

• 
Brings solid analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.

• 
Is motivated to learn, take initiative and develop your expertise over time.

• 
Is fluent in English, with Danish language skills considered an advantage.

• 
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:

• 
Tell us about a situation where you used data or structured analysis to understand a complex problem. What did you do, and what did you learn?

• 
Procurement transformation often requires business, people and technology to work together. Which part interests you most, and why?

• 
Describe a time when you worked with others to deliver a result under changing priorities or an unfamiliar set of circumstances. How did you contribute?

If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Senior consultant, Sascha Hjort at shjorth@kpmg.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!

Are you commercially driven, curious about market needs and passionate about turning insights into successful products? We are looking for a Product Manager to take commercial ownership of our workwear assortment within the Construction segment and help shape products that create real value for professional users.

Your role

As Product Manager, you will be the link between the market and our product development organization. You will translate customer needs, market insights and business strategy into competitive, relevant and profitable products.

You will take responsibility for development projects from initial decision through to launch, working closely with Design, Product Development, Purchasing & Quality, Production, Marketing and Sales. Once products are launched, you will follow their commercial performance and use market feedback and data to continuously optimize the assortment.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing market trends, customer needs, competitors and new developments within workwear and PPE

• Identifying product opportunities and assessing their market and commercial potential

• Defining product positioning, requirements, target pricing and expected profitability

• Preparing clear product briefs and driving development projects from concept to launch

• Working closely with Design and technical teams to ensure the right balance between functionality, quality, fit and market needs

• Coordinating cross-functional stakeholders throughout the development process to ensure progress and timely launches

• Building business cases and supporting commercial decisions for new products and collections

• Monitoring sales, profitability, assortment performance and market feedback and turning insights into concrete actions

• Driving continuous product improvements based on customer feedback, quality data and sustainability considerations

• Developing and optimizing the Construction assortment through product improvements, additions and phase-outs

• Providing clear product USPs and commercial input to Marketing and Sales

Who are you?

You combine a strong commercial mindset with an analytical and structured approach. You understand how customer and market needs translate into product opportunities and are comfortable taking ownership across several projects and stakeholders.

We expect that you:

• Have solid experience in product management and product development within technical textiles or apparel – ideally workwear

• Have experience with market and competitor analysis, benchmarking and product requirements

• Have successfully managed product development projects from concept to launch

• Have a good understanding of textile materials, functionality and technical product solutions

• Are commercially minded and comfortable working with pricing, margins and product performance

• Communicate and collaborate effectively across functions and cultures

• Are fluent in English

You will join a highly cross-functional environment where market understanding, product expertise and commercial thinking come together to develop a competitive and relevant workwear assortment for professional users.

What you can expect at our headquarters

Working at MASCOT is about more than the job itself. At our headquarters in Pårup, we want to create an environment where you can enjoy your working day, connect with colleagues and be part of an international organisation.

As part of the team, you can benefit from:

• On-site staff restaurant: daily freshly prepared meals available through our subsidised lunch scheme

• On-site gym: giving you the opportunity to stay active before or after work.

• Pension plan: providing additional security and helping you plan for the future

• Health insurance: giving you access to additional healthcare support when you need it

• An international working environment: collaborate with colleagues across different countries, functions and cultures

• Employee discounts: enjoy special discounts on MASCOT workwear and safety footwear

And most importantly, you will become part of a Danish family-owned company where collaboration, responsibility and long-term thinking are at the heart of how we work.

Ready to join us? We look forward to hearing from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We reserve the right to close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

At MASCOT, we value diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace. All applications are considered based on skills and qualifications, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other personal characteristic.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• 
A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

• 
Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

• 
Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

•

• 
The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

•

• 
A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

• 
Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

• 
Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

• 
Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

• 
Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

• 
International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

• 
Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

•

Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades.

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

Enrollment and employment terms

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

**Nice to have

**

• Experience working on live games

**Requirements For Any Job At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• You value a positive work environment

• You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

**Practicalities

**

• Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role

• 37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

• No crunch, we put people before deadlines

• Our working language is English

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects

• The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of paid vacation

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Pension plan and private health insurance

• Endless amounts of coffee

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We're looking for an experienced cyber and information security consultant in the GRC domain who has hands-on experience building automation and/or agentic tools into their work.

**We're scaling our GRC services team, a team dedicated to making governance, risk, and compliance of cyber and information security more efficient, effective, and valuable to organisations. We do this by automating processes through software and agentic tools, and by defining tasks, inputs, and outputs more clearly than is currently the norm.

This role is open to being shaped by your own passions and talents, whether that's software development, sales and marketing, or deep industry knowledge.

**In This Role, You'll Definitely Be

**

• Helping companies implement and comply with laws, standards, and frameworks like NIS 2, ISO 27001, and the CIS Controls

• Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

• Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

**Depending on your experience and interests, you may also be:

**

• Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

• Performing technical cybersecurity tasks in client environments

jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values : caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a Senior Business Consultant in Consulting, you will support our clients with best-practice market solutions and with services related to the use of SimCorp Dimension and beyond. You will work closely with local and global SimCorp teams, serving clients in their post-implementation phases. Drawing on your coordination skills and SimCorp Dimension expertise, you will collaborate with client and internal stakeholders on investment solutions, incident and problem management, and small changes or enhancements to current or future flows, all aimed at raising the level of automation and the end-user experience and satisfaction. Because the role is functional, Fund Administration & Accounting expertise is required. As part of your induction, you will work hands-on with our software and attend the three-week SimCorp Dimension® Academy, so you have steady support as you grow into the role.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Contribute to all aspects of SimCorp Dimension implementation projects.

• Advise on process improvements through better use of SimCorp Dimension, and help improve and document best practices for implementations.

• Map client needs to SimCorp Dimension functions and processes, and design and configure the setup.

• Lead the delivery of customised solutions with focus on Fund administration and Accounting.

• Assist clients in developing an overall test strategy and test plans, and support them in executing those plans.

• Drive the preparation and execution of test cases.

• Facilitate workshops to gather requirements for new and existing clients.

• Mentor, coach and enable colleagues to secure reliable project deliveries.

**What We Value

**

• Motivation to contribute and thrive in the position described above, which matters most.

• Proven skills in the areas below, however you gained them, as the route matters less than the capability.

• Investment accounting knowledge, some familiarity with any local GAAPS, IFRS9 would be an advantage

• Fund administration knowledge, including NAV calculation, Fund Structure and NAV Validation

• A strong background in effective consulting and project management.

• Demonstrated experience in software implementation projects.

• Enthusiasm for learning and using new software.

• A desire to act as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues.

• Good English, our corporate language, which is used in all communications.

• Knowledge of another European language is also appreciated. Danish is also an advantage

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Launchpad user our Lead Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

We’re looking for a proactive and curious student worker to join our Public Affairs Europe team. This is a unique opportunity to step into a highly visible role where personality, initiative, and strong interpersonal skills matter just as much as experience. In this role, you will support political engagement across multiple European markets, stakeholder coordination, and the operational excellence that makes strategic work possible.

You will gain direct exposure to a leading oncology biotech’s European policy landscape, develop insight into pharmaceutical policy and political strategy, and experience the dynamics of multi-market stakeholder engagement. At the same time, you will build hands-on experience in vendor management, procurement processes, and contract administration.

We are a small and agile team in Europe, currently the only Public Affairs presence in the region, working closely with colleagues in the US and across markets. This role is ideal for someone who is a self-starter, confident in sharing ideas, and not afraid to speak up. You enjoy working with others, building relationships, and navigating different stakeholders with empathy and strong communication skills. We offer flexibility around exams and study schedules, and an inclusive, supportive team environment where you are encouraged to grow and contribute from day one. Intended start date: 1 / 15 May.

Help us get to know you by submitting a comprehensive application, including your CV and motivational letter!

Responsibilities

Public Affairs

• Helping the team stay on top of political developments and initiatives across Europe.

• Supporting contact with different stakeholders like governments, patient organisations, and health authorities.

• Assisting in organising meetings and roundtables with external partners across European markets.

• Helping prepare clear and simple summaries, briefings, and communication materials.

• Supporting the organisation of events and conferences.

Operations & Administration

• Assisting with setting up and managing suppliers (vendors)

• Helping out with day-to-day administrative tasks where needed

• Supporting budget tracking and keeping an overview of costs

• Assisting with purchase orders and procurement processes

• Helping manage contracts and agreements

Requirements

• Actively enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program with approximately 2 years remaining before graduation.

• Based in Denmark, with a background in Political Science, Business, Public Health, Communications, or a related social science.

• Motivated by both political engagement and high-quality administrative execution.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-directed.

• Comfortable working with spreadsheets and managing processes efficiently.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, as it's Genmab's primary language.

• Available for approximately 20 hours per week.

About You

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose

• You bring precision and excellence to all that you do

• You believe in our rooted-in-science approach to problem-solving

• You are a generous collaborator who can work in teams with a broad spectrum of backgrounds

• You take pride in enabling the best work of others on the team

• You can grapple with the unknown and be innovative

• You have experience working in a fast-growing, dynamic company (or a strong desire to)

• You work hard and are not afraid to have a little fun while you do so!

Locations

Genmab maximizes the efficiency of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are crafted as open, community-based spaces that work to connect employees while being immersed in our powerful laboratories. Whether you’re in one of our office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

About Us

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose guiding its unstoppable team to strive towards improving the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For more than 20 years, its passionate, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and leveraged translational research and data sciences, which has resulted in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators, effector function enhanced antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates. To help develop and deliver novel antibody therapies to patients, Genmab has formed 20+ strategic partnerships with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO™) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with locations in Utrecht, the Netherlands, Princeton, New Jersey, U.S. and Tokyo, Japan.

• Thrive in a communicating role, enabling you to establish good professional collaborations

• Have a structured and analytical approach to your work

• Can work independently, and like having responsibility for your own tasks
